slots.jd.cloud-hosting.about:
About the role
Lattice Cloud is a cloud hosting startup, and we need a Systems Engineer who likes keeping things running. You'll look after the servers and services our customers rely on, fix what breaks, and help us get better at not breaking it again. We're a small team, so you'll own real work from day one and have a say in how we run operations.
slots.jd.cloud-hosting.duties:
What you'll do
- Take your turn on the on-call rotation and respond to alerts and outages on our hosting platform
- Write clear post-incident write-ups that cover what happened, why, and what we'll change
- Review and sign off change approvals so updates to production are planned and safe
- Tune monitoring and alerting so the team hears about real problems, not noise
- Automate repetitive operations work and keep runbooks up to date
slots.jd.cloud-hosting.needs:
What we're looking for
- 4 or more years of experience in systems engineering or IT operations
- Hands-on work with Terraform for infrastructure as code
- Scripting in Python and PowerShell to automate everyday tasks
- Experience with Prometheus for monitoring and Splunk for log search
- Familiarity with ServiceNow for tickets, incidents and change records
- Systems Administrator Certificate is a required certification
slots.r1.b1: Tunes monitoring alerts with PowerShell scripts that filter duplicate and low-value notifications, cutting alert noise by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Writes post-incident reviews using Grafana dashboards to show timelines and impact, giving the team a shared record of causes and follow-up actions.
slots.r1.b3: Plans patching cycles around backup and recovery checkpoints so every server has a restore point before updates, shortening each cycle by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Automates backup and recovery tests with Python scripts that restore sample data and confirm integrity, flagging failed restores before they affect production.
slots.r1.i1: As a Systems Engineer at Lantern Hill, tunes monitoring alerts so the team responds to real problems instead of noise.
slots.r1.i2: Systems Engineer at Lantern Hill who writes post-incident reviews that record causes, impact and follow-up work for the wider team.
slots.r2.b1: Built Bash scripting routines to collect disk, memory and CPU usage for capacity planning, improving forecast accuracy by 15 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Joined the on-call rotation for Kubernetes workloads, triaging pod failures and restarting services while following documented escalation steps.
slots.r2.b3: Moved change approvals to Terraform plan reviews, letting approvers see exact infrastructure changes and reducing approval time by 50 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Tuned monitoring alerts for Microsoft Azure resources, adjusting thresholds and removing duplicate rules so on-call staff received fewer false alarms.
slots.r2.i1: Junior Systems Administrator at Stonebridge Community Trust who drafted post-incident write-ups documenting what failed, how it was fixed and what changed afterward.
slots.r2.i2: Supported Stonebridge Community Trust as a Junior Systems Administrator, running regular backup and recovery tests to confirm data could be restored when needed.
slots.summary.1: Site reliability and IT operations professional with about 4 years of experience owning a service end to end, from monitoring and patching to incident follow-up. Works daily with Kubernetes, PowerShell and Microsoft Azure to keep systems stable and changes predictable.
slots.summary.2: IT operations and site reliability engineer with about 4 years of experience taking one workstream from design through daily operation. Uses Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure and PowerShell for automation, alert tuning and backup and recovery testing.
